description:
## X Patch 1.12.2-x.4 — Ahmed coexistence fix

All six patches can be selected together for X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01: Fix external post links; Hide Find more; Hide Who to follow; Hide sports scores (experimental); Hide search relevance prompt (experimental); Copy media URL (image/video/GIF from post options, images from photo long-press). Existing filters are retained. Image long-press adds a Copy media URL row without replacing native actions. The direct video/GIF MP4 URL is available from the post options action. The obsolete video downloader hook was removed because it does not match X 12.31.0. The presenter handler lookup was hardened for the Ahmed 1.24.2 coexistence case observed failing in x.3. Device retest is still required; video long-press is not implemented.
